### 2. `packages/core/core_network` multipart `upload()` — **Exists (complete)**

Package path: `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/core/core_network`

| Item | Location | Status |
|------|----------|--------|
| `HttpUploadFile` | `lib/src/http_client_interface.dart` | Exists |
| `HttpClient.upload()` | `lib/src/http_client_interface.dart` | Exists |
| `FormData` / `MultipartFile` | `lib/src/dio_http_client.dart` (Dio internals) | Exists |
| Implementation | `DioHttpClient.upload()` in `dio_http_client.dart` | Exists |
| Test | `test/upload_test.dart` | Exists |

`upload()` accepts `files: List<HttpUploadFile>`, optional `fields`, builds Dio `FormData`, and POSTs as `multipart/form-data`. Exported via `lib/core_network.dart`.

**Consumer:** `DefaultObjectRecognitionService.uploadImages()` in the feature package calls `_httpClient.upload(...)`.
